title: Miniatura Viral de Transformación Antes y Después para Desafío de 30 Días
prompt: Create a viral 'before and after' style thumbnail. Facial consistency: Use the person from the image, keeping facial features completely identical. Layout: Vertically split frame with jagged dividing line. Left side: Person with dejected/tired expression, black and white filter, slightly dim. Right side: Same person with confident/happy expression, high saturation color, bright lighting. Text elements: Top left red text: 'BEFORE', Top right green text: 'AFTER', Bottom center large text: '30-Day Challenge Transformed My Life!' Visual elements: Add thick arrow pointing right from left to right side, symbolizing transformation. Style: High contrast, dramatic lighting effects.
